name: structural-variant-detection
description: Detect structural variants (deletions, duplications, inversions, translocations) and copy number alterations. SV callers use multiple evidence types: split reads (SA tag), discordant read pairs (abnormal insert size or orientation), read depth changes, and assembly. Manta is the primary caller for Illumina data (split-read and paired-end evidence); DELLY adds B-allele frequency for genotyping. For CNV, CNVkit uses on-target and off-target coverage in exome data or uniform binning in WGS.
